summary: Join our Strategic Planning for Public Services Training Course. Gain essential skills to develop effective strategies for enhancing public service efficiency.
lede: Strategic planning for public services turns mandates and community needs into priorities, delivery plans and measurable service outcomes. For public service planners, policy analysts, programme managers and performance staff, it offers practical methods to assess context, rank initiatives against public value and resource limits, and map outcomes using a Theory of Change and logic model. You will also plan implementation, assign accountability, manage delivery risks and build scorecards to track progress.
audienceIntro: This public service strategy course is designed for professionals who translate mandates, policy priorities, and community needs into funded programmes, operating plans, and measurable outcomes.
modules: Strategic Planning for Public Services Priorities
Strategic Planning for Public Services Delivery
Strategic Planning for Public Services Scorecards
prerequisites: You need practical exposure to public policy, programme delivery, service operations, budgeting, performance reporting, or institutional planning. Prior strategic planning experience helps but is not essential. You should bring a laptop capable of running a current spreadsheet application and viewing Power BI files. No coding or programming is required because the digital exercises use provided templates and guided configuration.
